template-plain.why: item 233 (Justin 2026-10-19: "limit certain props to themed rooms. I a desk shouldn't be surrounded by grass. And generate several templates of rooms in biome 1 and limit what can occur in them"; "otherwise the rooms read as just random nonsense"); every room on Dungeon floors 1-5 takes exactly one template (world/templates.js), weighted by floor (weight: floors 1-5) and size (area: the cells it fits); pieces (where: wall, a run along one wall; north, against the north wall's middle; corner, heaped in corners; centre, through the middle; beside, next to the step before; inner, well inside; edge; near-water) are all that may stand in it; ground says what may grow or lie there; wear (207), walls (208, 231) and light (209) are read by their passes
